about: What the C library says for a locale on this Mac that this system's doesn't, with why. A Mac's C locale files (/usr/share/locale) come from old BSD tables, and don't agree with its own Foundation, which is what's being matched: that comparison, in locale-differences.json, has nothing in it. This system has one set of data, from CLDR.

differences.why: As %r: only for a locale that CLDR says uses twelve hours, and with CLDR's word for it.
The twelve-hour time's only there for a locale CLDR says uses twelve hours; a Mac's older tables have it for others too.
